what: A 4px line attached to the section’s left edge is tied to scroll and grows from a short stub (15rem) to the full section height (100%). It starts when 15% of the section touches the bottom of the screen and finishes when 70% of the section passes the top of the screen, with power2.inOut in between, so start and end are slow and the middle grows fast. With scrub 1 it trails the scroll by 1 second. Scrolling back up shrinks it again.

options.from: Starting length (css length), default 15rem — 5rem for long boards that group several images
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ”0.45,0,0.55,1”, default power2.inOut (bundled panels use none)
options.--fx-fill: Line fill (via style — gradients allowed), default navy-to-accent gradient
options.[data-fx-part=rail]: Growing line (direct child of the section, an empty div) — if absent, nothing is attached

note: Because it is a scrub with a curve, the line end does not move at the same rate as the scroll — it grows fastest while passing the middle of the section. With reduced motion it starts at full section height.

from.where: index.html .gb-two (two-column content section, 15rem→100%, 15% bottom→70% top, power2.inOut) · .gb-holder (long panel wrapping logo, copy and the two-column section, 5rem→100%, 10% bottom→90% top, none).
